items.headline: Historic Ayrton Senna Williams F1 car fails to sell at multi-million-dollar auction | Crash.net

sources.evidence_excerpt: Ayrton Senna © XPB Images A rare Williams Formula 1 car driven by three-time world champion Ayrton Senna has failed to sell at auction despite being valued at up to $6 million.
evidence_excerpts: Ayrton Senna © XPB Images A rare Williams Formula 1 car driven by three-time world champion Ayrton Senna has failed to sell at auction despite being valued at up to $6 million.
The Williams FW16B-01 is one of just two surviving chassis driven by the legendary Brazilian during his final season in Formula 1 in 1994.
However, the historic Formula 1 car failed to sell after bidding fell short of the undisclosed reserve price.
